Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia) 心境恶劣障碍 持续性抑郁障碍
ICD-9-CM code: 300.4
ICD-10-CM code: F34.1

Diagnostic criteria for Persistent Depressive Disorder (Dysthymia):

A. Depressed mood for most of the day, for more days than not, as indicated by
either subjective account or observation by others, for at least 2 years. Note:
In children and adolescents, mood can be irritable and duration must be at least
1 year.

B. Presence, while depressed mood, of two (or more) of the following:
1. Poor appetite or overeating.
2. Insomnia or hypersomnia.
3. Low energy or fatigue.
4. Low self-esteem.
5. Poor concentration or difficulty making decisions.
6. Feelings of hopelessness.

C. During the 2-year period of the disturbance, the individual has never been
without the symptoms in Criteria A and B for more than 2 months at a time.

D. During the first 2 years of the disturbance, there may have been one or more
major depressive episodes may have been present, but full criteria for major
depressive disorder were never met.

E. Criteria for a major depressive disorder may continuously be present for
2 years or more.

F. There has never been a manic episode or a hypomanic episode, and criteria
have never been met for cyclothymic disorder.

G. The disturbance is not better explained by a persistent psychotic disorder.

H. The symptoms are not attributable to the physiological effects of a substance
or another medical condition.

I. The symptoms cause clinically significant distress or impairment in social,
occupational, or other important areas of functioning.

Severity specifiers: mild (2-3 symptoms), moderate (4-5 symptoms), severe (6 or
more symptoms). Distress 苦痛, impairment 功能损害.
